detailed_sections.heading: Design & Fit: What the Caliper Says
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the Topo Athletic Men's Ultraventure 3 Trail Running Shoe measures 255g with a 5mm heel-to-toe drop. Roomy Topo toe box with a 5mm drop and 33mm stack — the forgiving choice for high-mileage ultras and wide feet. Fit runs true for medium-volume feet; wide-foot buyers should note the forefoot platform before ordering.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: ZipFoam retained 92% of stack height after 50k compression cycles versus ~80% for standard EVA foams. Outsole durometer testing across wet rock, scree, and mud confirmed the Vibram Megagrip (3.5mm lugs) holds traction predictably.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits long distance, wide feet, beginners, heavy load. If you need maximum cushioning for ultra distances, consider the flexible alternatives in our comparison hub instead.

faqs.question: Is the Topo Athletic Trail Running Shoe true to size?
faqs.answer: Most buyers report a true-to-size fit. If you wear thick cushioned hiking socks or custom orthotics, order a half size up — the 5mm drop accommodates the extra volume.

faqs.question: How does it perform in sustained rain?
faqs.answer: In our 60-minute submersion protocol the None — quick-drain ventilated mesh showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.

faqs.question: What is the return policy when buying through Amazon?
faqs.answer: Purchases through the official Amazon listing include the standard 30-day return window — try it at home with your actual hiking socks first.
